NOP.pipeline: Passes through pipeline with no effect

ADD.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag
ADD.operands: Ra: source and destination register, Rb: second source

SUB.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag
SUB.operands: Ra: source and destination register, Rb: second source

AND.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag

OR.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag

XOR.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag

NOR.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag

SLT.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag
SLT.notes: Uses signed comparison. Values with bit 15 set are negative.

SGT.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag
SGT.notes: Uses signed comparison. Values with bit 15 set are negative.

MUL.pipeline: Result in HI:LO, NOT Ra. Use MFHI/MFLO to read.
MUL.notes: Does NOT write to Ra. Insert 1 NOP before MFHI/MFLO.

SHL.summary: Ra = Ra << n (logical shift left, zero fill)
SHL.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag
SHL.operands: Ra: register, n: shift amount (0-15, immediate not register)

SHR.summary: Ra = Ra >> n (logical shift right, zero fill)
SHR.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag

SAR.summary: Ra = Ra >>> n (arithmetic shift right, sign-extend)
SAR.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag
SAR.notes: Preserves sign bit. Useful for dividing signed values by powers of 2.

ROL.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag

ROR.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag

LW.pipeline: Data at MEM stage. 1-cycle LW stall if next instr uses Rd.
LW.operands: Rd: destination, Rb: base register, offset: 4-bit unsigned (0-15)

SW.pipeline: Store at MEM stage. May stall if Rs still in flight.
SW.operands: Rs: source data, Rb: base register, offset: 4-bit unsigned (0-15)

LIU.summary: Rd[15:8] = imm8 (load upper byte, lower unchanged)
LIU.pipeline: Partial write at WB. NFW stall (up to 3 cycles) for dependents.
LIU.notes: Use with LIL to load a full 16-bit constant (LIU first, then LIL).

LIL.summary: Rd[7:0] = imm8 (load lower byte, upper unchanged)
LIL.pipeline: Partial write at WB. NFW stall (up to 3 cycles) for dependents.
LIL.notes: Preserves upper byte. LIU+LIL pair = LIW pseudo-instruction.

ADDI.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | Forwarding: full | Updates Z flag
ADDI.operands: Rd: source and destination, imm8: signed (-128 to +127)

J.pipeline: Resolves: ID | 1 flush slot | Range: ±2047 instructions

JAL.summary: R15 = PC + 2; PC = PC + 1 + offset (jump and link / call)
JAL.pipeline: Resolves: ID | 1 flush slot | Return addr in R15
JAL.notes: R15 gets PC+2 (skips flush slot). Use JR R15 to return.

JR.pipeline: Resolves: ID | 1 flush slot | Stalls if Rs in ALU/MEM
JR.notes: Commonly used as JR R15 to return from JAL.

BZ.T.summary: Branch if Z=1 (result was zero): PC = PC + 2 + offset
BZ.T.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | 2 flush slots | Z set by R/S-type only
BZ.T.notes: Z flag only updated by R-type and S-type instructions.

BZ.N.summary: Branch if Z=0 (result was non-zero): PC = PC + 2 + offset
BZ.N.pipeline: Resolves: ALU | 2 flush slots | Z set by R/S-type only

PUSH.pipeline: SP update at WB. SP forwarding allows back-to-back PUSH.

POP.pipeline: Like LW — 1-cycle stall if next instr uses Rd.

SPRD.summary: Rd = SP (read stack pointer to GPR)
SPRD.pipeline: Routes SP through ALU. Full forwarding, no stalls.

SPWR.summary: SP = Rs (write GPR to stack pointer)

MFHI.summary: Rn = HI (move from HI register to GPR)
MFHI.pipeline: NFW stall for dependents. Insert 1 NOP after MUL.

MFLO.summary: Rn = LO (move from LO register to GPR)
MFLO.pipeline: NFW stall for dependents. Insert 1 NOP after MUL.

MTHI.summary: HI = Rn (move from GPR to HI register)

MTLO.summary: LO = Rn (move from GPR to LO register)

AIH.summary: HI = HI + imm8 (add immediate to HI)

AIL.summary: LO = LO + imm8 (add immediate to LO)

AIS.summary: HI += imm8; LO += imm8 (add immediate to both)

LPM.summary: Rn = PMEM[Rb] (load word from program memory)
LPM.pipeline: Reads instruction memory instead of data memory.

SYSCALL.summary: Software trap: EPC=addr+2, ECA={1,svc#}, IEN=0, PC=0x0002
SYSCALL.pipeline: Resolves: ID | 1 flush slot | Jumps to exception vector
SYSCALL.notes: Service number (0-255) stored in ECA bits 7:0.

RETI.summary: Return from exception: PC = EPC, IEN = 1
RETI.pipeline: Resolves: ID | 1 flush slot | Re-enables interrupts

EI.pipeline: Takes effect at ID stage. No flush slots.

DI.pipeline: Takes effect at ID stage. No flush slots.

MFEPC.summary: Rn = EPC (read exception return address to GPR)
MFEPC.pipeline: ALU pass-through. Full forwarding, no stalls.

MFECA.summary: Rn = ECA (read exception cause to GPR)
MFECA.pipeline: ALU pass-through. Full forwarding, no stalls.

MTEPC.summary: EPC = Rn (write GPR to exception return address)
MTEPC.pipeline: EPC written at WB. Stalls if RETI/MFEPC follows within 2 cycles.
